items.q: I mean, he was a tap dancer himself, Jimmy Gibbons, you know.

ctx.x: Well, they had dancers and singers, a chorus line and everything, and singers... I mean, he was a tap dancer himself, Jimmy Gibbons, you know. And it was a really nice experience to add to my, heh, experiences, you know.
